title: BillCategoriesPayload
description: Categorize-only LLM pass contract. No enum for category names — active-set membership enforced in BillCategoryAssigner after parse. The categories array is bounded in both directions: the item bound is Category::MAX_NAME_CHARS (100), the longest name a Category record can hold, so a longer name could never match an active category anyway, and no honest answer is refused. The same bound and the same reason apply to the categories array in bill_summary.json.
